core_obligations: Construction (proof lines 827-836): omega_X^bullet is the relative dualizing complex a(O_Spec(k)); property (4), the functorial Ext-versus-H^[-i]-duality compatible with shifts and triangles, holds by construction since a is the right adjoint of f_*, and for proper f it coincides with f^!(O_Spec(k)).

Properties (1) and (2) (proof lines 838-842): cohomology concentrated in degrees -1 and 0, with omega_X = H^{-1} a coherent Cohen-Macaulay module supported exactly on the one-dimensional irreducible components, by the vanishing lemma for good dualizing complexes.

Property (3) (proof lines 843-849): at a closed point x the stalk omega_{X,x}^bullet is a normalized dualizing complex, and the apply-CM lemma gives H^0 nonzero exactly when dim O_{X,x} = 0 or dim = 1 with O_{X,x} not Cohen-Macaulay.

Properties (5) and (6) (proof lines 850-856): the H^1-duality Hom(F, omega_X) = Hom_k(H^1(X, F), k) comes from the proper-over-A dualizing module lemma for coherent F and by unwinding (4) at K = F[0], i = -1 in general; for smooth relative dimension 1 the identification with Omega_{X/k} is the smooth-proper lemma.
proof_roadmap: Define the dualizing complex as the relative dualizing object and read off property (4) from adjointness.
Import cohomological vanishing and CM support for properties (1) and (2).
Localize at closed points via the normalized dualizing complex for property (3).
Unwind the adjunction for the H^1-duality of property (5) and cite the smooth case for property (6).

The proof (lines 827-856) is a complete reference chain: the relative dualizing definition with adjointness giving (4), the vanishing and CM-support inputs for (1) and (2), the normalized-local criterion for (3), and the unwinding plus smooth-case citations for (5) and (6). Every step is present with no omissions; the footnote even records the Yoneda characterization of the complex.
